(3) She appears in a bustling city square with historical buildings, spinning around happily while wearing sunglasses and a patterned headband. (4) Close-ups of a student ID card and a red logo that reads 'college' on a white wall. (5) The woman is seen studying with a male teacher in a modern office-like setting, then enjoying a meal in a brightly lit, modern cafe with a large group of people. (7) A sequence shows various lifestyle amenities: a modern laundry room, a gym with weight machines, and a sunny outdoor swimming pool surrounded by red metal structures. (8) On a moving train, the woman smiles at the camera, then eats a cone of gelato. (9) A large group of diverse young people waves and cheers in a park near a grand fountain. (10) Nightlife scenes feature the woman dancing in a dark club illuminated by vibrant green neon lights and lasers. (11) She is seen lounging on a beanbag chair with a book over her face, then taking selfies in a crowded outdoor area. (12) Multiple shots focus on young, attractive men sitting in a park or walking by. (13) The woman sits in a cafe, intensely focused on a Spanish textbook and writing notes. (14) She practices speaking in a classroom setting, appearing animated and engaged. (15) Finally, she walks away from a majestic fountain in a park, her backpack on, as the camera follows her movement.
